eventDetail.scope: ICECC brings together researchers, engineers, academics, and industry practitioners to share original research and foster collaboration across engineering, computing, and cybernetics. Topics include AI & machine learning, cybersecurity, cloud/distributed computing, power systems & renewable energy, VLSI & signal processing, robotics & control systems, mechatronics & automation, biomedical engineering, and emerging areas such as IoT, blockchain, and smart cities.  The conference emphasizes interdisciplinary, convergent research addressing real-world challenges that span multiple engineering domains. ICECC welcomes theoretical, applied, and experimental contributions, and aims to strengthen collaboration between academia, industry, and professional bodies — supporting research capacity and innovation, particularly within emerging research ecosystems.
